pages.title: Finding Zinc
pages.text: Default deposits: Overworld, Y 0 to 128. Veins target up to 8 blocks, with 10 placement attempts per chunk. Mining requirement: level 1.

pages.title: Working Zinc
pages.text: Smelt Zinc Ore or Zinc Dust into ingots. Crushing the ore first normally yields two dusts. Ingots can be stored as metal blocks or converted into the material's other crafting forms.
